todo.title: Connect the database
todo.how: Run sh scripts/supabase-create.sh NAME; it creates the project and writes the password only to .env. Then set the database address from the project's connection string.

todo.title: Connect file storage
todo.how: Create the storage bucket in Supabase and set its name and keys.

todo.title: Connect email sending
todo.how: Verify the sending domain and set the key.

todo.title: Set up the self-hosted runners
todo.how: Install at least two runners as services with add-runner.ps1, run the doctor and the Runner check workflow, then set the done flag.

todo.title: Set the session signing key
todo.how: Copy the JWT secret from the Supabase project's settings into the environment.

todo.title: Schedule the backup
todo.how: Turn on the nightly dump to the backup bucket and set the done flag once the first one has run.

todo.title: Use the Standard build machine on Vercel
todo.how: In the Vercel project's Settings, Build and Deployment, set the build machine to Standard, the cheapest; a bigger one bills more for every build. Then set the done flag.

todo.title: Set a spend cap on Vercel
todo.how: In the team's Settings, Billing, Spend Management, set a monthly cap and an alert below it, so a runaway week of builds stops at a number you chose. Then set the done flag.

todo.title: Set branch protection on main
todo.how: Run sh scripts/protect-main.sh, which sets the only check (CI passed), up to date off and a pull request required, then set the done flag.

systems.name: Source control and CI
systems.vendor: GitHub, Actions on the studio's runners
systems.does: Holds the code, runs the checks on the self-hosted runners, and merges the queue.

how.a: Run the merge queue with --drain. It merges every green pull request, as a batch when there are more than two, waits for the rest, and names anything that needs a person. Never merge directly.

Take the next number with the next-number script, write the file under supabase/migrations, run it against the project, mark its line Done in the setup document on the same branch, then queue the pull request. The queue refuses a migration that has not run.

Create the key in the service's dashboard, store it in the password manager under the project's entry, set it in the environment, and add a line to the setup document. The card for that service turns ready on its own.
Rotate the JWT secret in the Supabase project's settings, set the new value in every environment the same hour, and record the date in the setup document. Open sessions sign in again.
Run the nightly backup job from the Actions tab with the manual trigger. It writes a dated dump to the backup bucket.
Nothing in this project deletes. Move files to the archive folder in the bucket; a nightly job moves anything older than a year there on its own.
Reports arrive as issues labeled report. Reply on the issue, change what needs changing in a pull request, and close the issue; the reporter gets the reply by email.

when.a: Jobs wait; there is no hosted fallback on a personal account. The session brief says so at every session start, the nightly audit comments on the audit issue once a runner is back, and the merge queue says so rather than merging. Start the runner service and the queued jobs run.
The full run opens an issue labeled ci-red. Nothing else merges until it is closed. The nightly audit keeps mentioning it while it is open.

when.q: A pull request's preview fails to build?
when.a: Vercel comments on the pull request with the build log. The pull request is not green until the preview builds, so the queue leaves it alone; fix the build on the branch.
A free Supabase project pauses after a week without traffic. The app shows its plain outage page and the console card turns to do. Resume it from the dashboard; nothing is lost.
Supabase emails the owner at eighty percent. The nightly audit comments on the tracking issue when the bucket passes ninety percent.
